problem_description: Compute the average density in kg/m^3 and the coordination number for the liquid argon system. The system consisted of 108 argon atoms with a mass of 39.948 amu, in a cubic box of size 3 nm. The intermolecular interactions were described using the 12–6 Lennard–Jones potential with parameters 𝜎 = 0.341 nm and 𝜀 = 2.7458 × 10−2 kJ mol−1. Lorentz–Berthelot mixing rules were employed for non-bonded interactions. The energy minimization should be performed using steepest-descent algorithm with a total steps of 50000 with emstep of 0.01 nm. The equlibration run for 5,00,000 steps with 1 fs timesteps and it should use the leap-frog integrator. The temperature was maintained at 87.21 K using the velocity-rescale (v-rescale) thermostat with coupling constant of 1 ps and pressure was controlled at 1 bar using Berendsen barostat with coupling constant of 2 ps. This simulation should not involve with production run, all the analysis should be performed only on equilibration outputs. The rdf should be computed using the gromacs tool gmx rdf.
